diagnosis.what_happened: Executed script failed with AssertionError: replacements_count is 1, expected 6
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: The script hardcoded search strings with literal numbering prefixes (e.g. '۱) ', '۲) '), but in OpenXML list numbering is stored in paragraph properties and is NOT present in run text.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Search logic should exclude list prefixes and match actual paragraph text.
diagnosis.rationale_why: OpenXML documents decouple structural list formats from paragraph content strings.

desired_behavior: Search for exact run text stripped of assumed OpenXML numPr prefixes or match by paragraph content normalized of numPr
generalization: In OpenXML docx documents, list numbering (e.g. ۱), 1., a)) is stored in <w:pPr><w:numPr> and does not exist in <w:r><w:t>; search strings must match the actual run text without literal numbering prefixes

evidence.observed_value: Failure to match text containing hardcoded list numbering prefixes
evidence.threshold_value: Zero hardcoded list numbers in OpenXML text search
